about.text: A Russian hard rennet cheese of about 45% fat, made from pasteurised cow's milk with a bacterial starter and rennet, and ripened 30 to 45 days. It is named after the Poshekhonye cheese-making plant in Yaroslavl Oblast and is still made at other plants in Russia and Belarus.
